title: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm – Retirement/Death of a Partner

topics.title: Amount due to a retiring or deceased partner

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the items that are credited to a retiring or deceased partner when ascertaining the amount due.
Identify the items deducted from the claim of a retiring or deceased partner and compute the net amount due.

topics.title: New profit sharing ratio and gaining ratio

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate the new profit sharing ratio of continuing partners after retirement or death of a partner.
Calculate the gaining ratio as new share minus old share and interpret a gain or sacrifice.
Adjust the retiring partner's share of goodwill through the gaining partners' capital accounts.
Write off goodwill already appearing in the books among all partners in the old ratio.
Compute hidden goodwill when a lump sum paid exceeds the amount due to the outgoing partner.

topics.title: Revaluation of assets and liabilities and accumulated profits and losses

concepts.learning_objective: Prepare the Revaluation Account and distribute the gain or loss among all partners in the old ratio.
Transfer reserves and accumulated losses to all partners' capital accounts in the old ratio.

topics.title: Share of profit up to the date of retirement or death

concepts.learning_objective: Calculate an outgoing partner's share of profit for the intervening period on time, average-profit or sales basis.
Record the outgoing partner's share of profit through Profit and Loss Suspense Account and close it.

topics.title: Disposal of amount due to retiring partner

concepts.learning_objective: State the outgoing partner's entitlement under Section 37 of the Indian Partnership Act, 1932.
Prepare the retiring partner's loan account for payment in instalments with interest.
Determine the new capital of each continuing partner in the new profit sharing ratio.
Compute and record the cash to be brought in or withdrawn by continuing partners.

topics.title: Death of a partner and the executors' account

concepts.learning_objective: Compute the components of a deceased partner's claim up to the date of death.
Transfer the deceased partner's claim to the executors' account and settle it.
